_note: The upstream's own response body, passed through untouched — this solution adds authentication, not transformation. Assert the status and that the body is your backend's normal payload. The array below is illustrative for a Posts API.
_upstream_receives: X-Access-Token, because set_access_token_header is true. set_id_token_header and set_userinfo_header are false, so no X-ID-Token and no X-Userinfo — and no userinfo round trip to Okta per request.
